prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Quick Desktop Shortcuts & Controls", "Learn how to easily toggle pet visibility and interact with your companion on your desktop.", "Press key shortcut to hide or show pet", "Right click tray icon for full settings"]
1: ["Official Companion Adoption Certificate", "Your pet certificate is permanently linked to your account."]
2: ["Upload & Verify Companion Photo", "Clear facial lighting & front orientation"]
3: ["Mastering Your Desktop Companion Controls", "Use quick tray controls and shortcuts to summon, move, or hide your companion anytime."]
4: ["Signing in automatically restores all pets, items, and companion data linked to your account."]
5: []
6: ["Front-facing photos with clear lighting yield the most accurate pet generation results."]
7: ["Your selected companion path and progress will be securely saved to your account profile."]
8: ["Generating Your Pet in the Background", "Your companion is rendering safely. You will be notified the moment your pet is ready on your desktop."]
9: ["Sign In to Protect & Restore Your Companion"]
